text:
The password security practice described in the text contains a significant weakness: writing passwords on post-it notes and sticking them to the monitor. This is a risky behavior because it exposes sensitive credentials to anyone who can see the workspace, effectively negating the complexity of the password itself. Physical security is a critical component of overall security, and storing passwords in plain sight defeats the purpose of using complex characters.

Regarding the priority question: The name of the planet humans live on is Earth.
